scene.name: B1_rectangular_spiral_barrier
scene.educational_message: A boundary-attached separator forces every feasible path through a region farther from the goal than the start.

source_details.source_type: analytic geometry plus deterministic physics-valid reference

distance_barrier.justification: The radius-inflated lower wall touches the left boundary, so every start-to-goal centre path must pass its right edge.

fitness_distinction.euclidean: negative minimum distance over the complete episode
fitness_distinction.final_euclidean: negative distance at the final episode position
